outcome: Accuracy of ultrasound estimated fetal weight (EFW) compared to actual birth weight (BW)
cohort: 374 pregnant women carrying a single fetus at term
finding: Ultrasound estimation of fetal weight tends to underestimate birth weight, especially in cases of macrosomia.
gest_age: Term (mean gestational age at delivery: 39.93 weeks)
birth_weight: Macrosomia (>4000g or above 90th percentile for gestational age)
